{{- /* A guide page's Props table as Markdown, from its version's api_props.json (api-data.html). generate-reference.ts writes one table per symbol the guides name, from the same model and in the same run as the API reference, so the table and the reference cannot disagree. Nothing is committed. The page's api_symbols are tried in order and the first with a table wins; props_interfaces only count when the page has no api_symbols (the rule refresh-props used). Links arrive as `[text](apiref:)`: each becomes the page's RelPermalink (a folded member's section on its parent's page, api-page-url.html), which holds under any baseURL, or plain text when the page doesn't exist. Used by the props shortcode ({{% props %}} in a page), in the HTML page and its Markdown version. Expects: the page. Returns the Markdown table, or "" when there is none. */ -}} {{- $out := "" -}} {{- with (partialCached "api-data.html" $ $.Section).props -}} {{- $tables := . -}} {{- $keys := slice -}} {{- with $.Params.api_symbols -}} {{- $keys = . -}} {{- else -}} {{- range $.Params.props_interfaces }}{{ $keys = $keys | append (printf "props_interfaces:%s" .) }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- range $keys -}} {{- if not $out }}{{ with index $tables . }}{{ $out = . }}{{ end }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- range findRE `\[[^\]]*\]\(apiref:[^)\s]+\)` $out | uniq -}} {{- $link := . -}} {{- $text := replaceRE `^\[([^\]]*)\].*$` "$1" $link -}} {{- $path := replaceRE `^.*\(apiref:([^)\s]+)\)$` "$1" $link -}} {{- $to := $text -}} {{- with site.GetPage $path }}{{ $to = printf "[%s](%s)" $text (partial "api-page-url.html" .) }}{{ end -}} {{- $out = replace $out $link $to -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $out -}}
